name: Castiglione Falletto
shape: Eurostat LAU, the commune it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

notes: Tar and roses are its classic aromas, along with notes such as cherry, licorice, leather, truffle, herbs and dried fruit.
It ages well and takes on a rust-red tinge as it matures.

blurb.text: One of the communes of the Barolo zone in Piedmont, southwest of Alba. Barolo is a red DOCG made from Nebbiolo and often described as one of Italy's greatest wines.
